assessment_prompt: Assess purpose, requirements and repository evidence before comparing approaches. For small fixes favor focused implementation changes and relevant edge-case coverage. For features exclude code-change volume from ranking and assess design and maintainability through actual consequences. For mixed work identify scopes and assign applicable rubrics. Select criteria, positive percentage weights totaling 100 and explicit 0/50/100 anchors, rationale, mandatory constraints and original source references. Judge architectural decisions with that rubric and supplied evaluation guidance, without a predefined defect checklist.

scoring.profile_selection_prompt: Assess purpose and scope to select criteria, percentage weights and scoring anchors with an evidence-backed rationale. Favor focused changes and relevant edge coverage for small fixes; exclude change volume when ranking feature approaches. Assign applicable rubrics to mixed scopes.

selection.prompt: Assess confidence and sensitivity to LOC and complexity estimates. Accept a clear winner only with supported feasibility, adequate score lead and no unresolved material doubts. For a sole feasible option substantiate rejection of every alternative.
